products.title: Piretti Garsen QUAD Tour 17" Putter Grip
products.body_html:
The Quad Tour also works great for claw, and saw style putting grips. With a flat topline and bottom, players can easy square up the putter face with complete consistency every time.

The QUAD TOUR grip gives you the benefits of the EDGE and MAX but places your hands in a traditional position.

The shape turns your elbows into your body and sets your shoulders back. This relieves arm and shoulder tension, inhibits wrist action, which takes “the hands out of the putting” and promotes shoulder rotation, creating a solid putting stroke, which will give you a one-piece feel, leading to a more consistent stroke.

Grip diameter: 1.4 Inches
Weight:  120 Grams
Core Size: .600
Outside diameter: Midsize
Shock Absorption: High
Material: High-Tech PU Material
Feel: Semi-tacky
Length: 17"

Milled entirely from 303 stainless steel, each putter features a mid-milled face for a quiet sound and exceptionally soft, controlled feel. Every head design has been Tour tested and inspired by Mike Johnson’s desire to create a true no-torque stroke while maintaining the classic look and feel Piretti is known for. The Cerakote finish is virtually maintenance-free, and all No-Torque putters are paired with a KBS steel shaft, Piretti headcover, and Piretti grip. The Modena continues to bolster our lineup of high-MOI mallet putters with a center-shafted design, 70° lie angle, and a fully milled 303 stainless steel construction. One of its standout features is its adjustable weighting system, allowing golfers to fine-tune the head weight from 355g to 375g based on their preferred feel and setup. The weights are strategically positioned to maintain the putter’s balance, meaning golfers can adjust the head weight without compromising the no-torque technology or performance. The result is a highly stable, confidence-inspiring mallet that combines the simplicity of a no-torque stroke with the ability to personalize feel and head weight. Simply line it up and fire away.

The Premier Series is the newest edition to the Piretti Golf lineup. Milled entirely from 303-stainless steel featuring a fine milled face for a distinct sound and exceptionally soft feel. Each of the head designs has been Tour tested and inspired by Mike Johnson’s desire for a classic look and feel.  The satin finish provides a beautiful look that is virtually maintenance free. products.title: DEMO Piretti 303 Midnight Series Lucca W/BGT Stability Golf Tour Shaft
products.body_html:
DEMO Piretti Midnight Black Series Lucca

The 303 Series is the newest edition to the Piretti Golf lineup. Milled entirely from 303-stainless steel featuring deep milled grooves for a distinct sound and buttery soft feel. Each of the head designs has been Tour tested and inspired by Mike Johnson’s desire for a classic look and feel.  The Black PVD Finish provides a beautiful look that is virtually maintenance free and eliminates glare. This 303 Series Lucca is paired with a BGT Stability Golf Tour Black shaft, and our Piretti Signature Grip available in eight colors.

The Lucca is a twist on the blade style putter, with inspiration from the popular Matera head style with a more traditional blade influence, milled from a solid billet of  303 stainless steel. It is also made with a deep milled face to give it a soft feel. It is offered in right hand and 365 gram headweight.

products.title: DEMO Piretti Elite Series Cortino 2
products.body_html:
DEMO Piretti Elite Series Cortino 2

Meet the Piretti Elite Series, a line built for golfers who demand precision, feel, and classic design.

Milled from a solid billet of 303 Stainless steel the elite series has an incredible feel, balance and retains the legendary Piretti quality. The Cortino Elite features a deep milled face, 430 toe hang and a satin finish for reduced glare.

Designed with a modern refined styling and details that enhance both look and performance, the Elite Series was designed to look as good as it performs.

products.title: Premier Series Bosa PN - Custom W/UST Graphite Shaft
products.body_html:
The Premier Series is the newest edition to the Piretti Golf lineup. Milled entirely from 303-stainless steel featuring a fine milled face for a distinct sound and exceptionally soft feel. Each of the head designs has been Tour tested and inspired by Mike Johnson’s desire for a classic look and feel.  The satin finish provides a beautiful look that is virtually maintenance free. All of the Premier Series putters are paired with a UST Graphite shaft, white headcover, and our Piretti Touring Pro Black Grip.

The Bosa traces it’s heritage to the original Bosa half mallet putter milled from a solid billet  303 stainless steel, with a plumbers neck hosel to achieve a 45* toe-hang result. It is a one piece precision milled head available in 365 grams. We added extra weight by increasing the flange width and thickness which lowers the center of gravity, promotes a more effective roll, and a more appealing sound. The wider flange also allows us to add a longer sight line to help with alignment as well as accuracy.

products.title: "Heaven's 27" Tribute Putter - Potenza 2 LN
products.body_html:
Piretti has proudly created these putters in order to raise funds for the Heaven’s 27 Foundation. The Potenza WB LN Heavens 27 edition putter is milled from 303 stainless steel featuring a classic style and unforgettable details in remembrance of the “Heaven’s 27.” 

A message from the Heaven’s 27 Foundation

The Foundation was created not simply to remember, but to continue what our girls began. While we can no longer hold them in our arms, we carry them forward through action—lifting others as they so naturally did in life.

Donating to Heaven’s 27 will fund the individual girls’ foundations equally. Our initiatives may be diverse, but our mission is clear: to honor their legacy by strengthening our communities and making them shine brighter. This Foundation is, in every sense, the sum of their hearts.

As families, we have found resilience in one another and purpose in building something greater than our loss. Guided by faith, we believe their story continues—and through this work, we ensure it does.

A message from both Piretti and the Heaven’s 27 Foundation

Thank you to all those who have decided to support the foundation and the families of the 27 children and counselors that tragically lost their lives on July 4th. To learn more please visit the foundations website at heavens27.org

Additional Customization

For any additional customization please email josh@pirettigolf.com

The Bosa traces it’s heritage to the original Bosa half mallet putter milled from a solid billet  303 stainless steel, with a plumbers neck hosel to achieve a 45* toe-hang result. We added extra weight by increasing the flange width and thickness which lowers the center of gravity, promotes a more effective roll, and a more appealing sound. The wider flange also allows us to add a longer sight line to help with alignment as well as accuracy.

products.title: Cottonwood II  – 303 Midnight Series

products.title: Virtual Putter Fitting
products.body_html:
How it works:

1. Record your putter swing with a camera. Simplest option is to use your cell phone. We’ll need two angles.
– The first, from in front (as if you are putting towards the camera)
– The second, a side view (from the ball side facing the golfer)

2. Upload the videos and basic information about yourself and your putter. Your height, current putter specs, etc.

3. Once submitted, our team of golf pro’s utilize the same techniques as an in person putter fitting to diagnose your swing and make recommendations.

Our team of experts request 3 business days to diagnose your swing, and will provide a detailed report via email.

This is the Piretti branded Garsen Golf “G-Pro Max” Putter Grip.

products.title: Piretti Signature Forged Cavity Back Irons
products.body_html:
Limited Edition Forged Irons - Cavity Back
Sets include: 4-iron through Pitching Wedge

Inspired by the best players in the game, designed for golfers seeking maximum shot control with the traditional forged feel. The new Piretti Signature Forged Irons were designed with forgiveness and shotmaking in mind. Each club head is hand-ground to Piretti specifications for precision performance.

The Cavity Back Irons were developed with a more modern cavity blade to position the center of gravity lower providing increased launch and spin for forgiveness and control. These classic irons feature a rounded toe and slight mid-size frame, providing forgiveness and superior workability. All of the Piretti irons have a slightly rounded leading edge for less digging and precise turf performance.

The Signature Forged Iron heads can be paired with either the latest graphite shafts from LA Golf or the standard KBS FLT steel shafts to achieve consistent ball striking throughout the set.

Each set is custom made and is currently a 3-4 week lead time for production. Please contact us with any questions.

This extended-length grip offers enhanced versatility for counterbalance and arm-lock putting styles, while the ergonomic pistol shape promotes a natural hand position for improved consistency and feel.

products.title: 303 Midnight Series Bosa FN
products.body_html:
The 303 Midnight Series is a cornerstone of the Piretti Golf lineup. Each putter is milled entirely from 303-stainless steel and features a finely milled face that delivers a distinct sound and buttery-soft feel. Every head design has been Tour-tested and reflects Mike Johnson’s commitment to classic aesthetics and performance. The Midnight Black finish offers a clean, glare-free look that is virtually maintenance-free. All 303 Series putters come paired with a KBS steel shaft, a white 303 Midnight headcover, and our Piretti Signature Lamkin grip (available in red or black).

 

The Bosa traces it's heritage to the original Bosa half mallet putter milled from a solid billet  303 stainless steel, with a flow neck hosel to achieve a 40* toe-hang result. It is a one piece precision milled head available in 365 grams. We added extra weight by increasing the flange width and thickness which lowers the center of gravity, promotes a more effective roll, and a more appealing sound. The wider flange also allows us to add a longer sight line to help with alignment as well as accuracy.

products.title: Piretti Classic Cavity Back Irons
products.body_html:
Piretti Classic Cavity Back Irons 
4-iron through Pitching Wedge

Inspired by the best players in the game, designed for golfers seeking maximum shot control with the traditional forged feel, with more modern lofts. The new Piretti Classic Irons were designed with forgiveness and shotmaking in mind. Each club head is hand-ground to Piretti specifications for precision performance.

The Cavity Back Irons were developed with a more modern cavity pocket to position the center of gravity lower providing increased launch and spin for forgiveness and control. These classic irons feature a rounded toe and very slight offset, providing forgiveness and superior workability. The Classic irons have a slightly rounded leading edge and narrow sole for less digging and precise turf performance.

Shaft options include the KBS Tour V and C-Taper Lite.

Piretti 801 Damascus Handstamped Putter

We are proud to introduce the first of eight one-off Piretti 801D Workshop putters. Damascus steel is known for its sleek look, beautiful aesthetics, and crisp yet soft feel. Creating a putter from Damascus is a tedious process involving folding metal as much as 32 times, with each layer being welded on top of one another. The result is a solid billet block that when milled into shape gives Damascus putters the unique wavy pattern that you see today.

products.title: Tour Only Potenza 2 Limited - Custom (Naked)
products.body_html:
Meet the latest Limited Edition in the line of Piretti performance putters, our Tour Only Potenza 2 .

Available right-handed only, and limited to 300 pieces, the putter comes with your choice of one of several limited edition Tour Only headcovers. Milled from a solid billet of 303 Stainless steel the Potenza 2 features a classic inspired look, creating incredible feel and balance and retains the legendary Piretti quality. The Potenza 2 carries a head weight of 365g, features a deep milled face, a satin finish for reduced glare, and 4:30 toe hang.

Designed with a modern refined styling and details that enhance both look and performance, the Tour Only Potenza 2 was designed to look as good as it performs.

products.title: Tour Only Potenza 2 Limited - Custom W/UST Graphite Shaft
products.body_html:
Meet the latest Limited Edition in the line of Piretti performance putters, our Tour Only Potenza 2 .

Available right-handed only, and limited to 300 pieces, the putter comes with your choice of one of several limited edition Tour Only headcovers. Milled from a solid billet of 303 Stainless steel the Potenza 2 features a classic inspired look, creating incredible feel and balance and retains the legendary Piretti quality. The Potenza 2 carries a head weight of 365g, features a deep milled face, a satin finish for reduced glare, and 4:30 toe hang.

Designed with a modern refined styling and details that enhance both look and performance, the Tour Only Potenza 2 was designed to look as good as it performs.

products.title: Cottonwood II - Premier Series - Custom W/UST Graphite Shaft
products.body_html:
The 303 Midnight Series is milled entirely from 303-stainless steel featuring thin milled face for a distinct sound and buttery soft feel. Each of the head designs has been Tour tested and inspired by Mike Johnson’s desire for a classic look and feel.  The Midnight Black finish provides a beautiful look that is virtually maintenance free and eliminates glare. All of the 303 Series putters are paired with a KBS steel shaft, beautiful white 303 Midnight headcover, and our Piretti Signature Lamkin grip(available in red or black).

The Cottonwood II is a blade style putter milled from a solid billet 303 stainless steel. It is a one piece precision milled head available in 375 grams. We added extra weight by increasing the flange width and thickness which lowers the center of gravity, promotes a more effective roll, and a more appealing sound. The wider flange also allows us to add a longer sight line to help with alignment as well as accuracy.

products.title: Piretti CL-01 Cavity Back Irons
products.body_html:
Piretti CL-01 Cavity Back Irons 
4-iron through Pitching Wedge

Inspired by the best players in the game, the Piretti CL-01 irons for mid-to-high-level players and are forged from S20C carbon steel, meticulously manufactured through computer numerical control. This new Piretti iron features low offset and a slight cavity-back design, allowing for shot-making and a satisfying butter-feel hitting feel, while also providing the performance that all golfers want.

Shaft options include the KBS Tour V and C-Taper Lite.

products.title: Piretti Forged Muscle-Cavity Back Irons
products.body_html:
Piretti Forged Muscle-Cavity Back Irons 
4-iron through Pitching Wedge

Inspired by the best players in the game, designed for golfers seeking maximum shot control with the traditional forged feel, with more modern lofts. The new muscle-cavity irons were designed with forgiveness and shotmaking in mind. Each club head is hand-ground to Piretti specifications for precision performance.

These forged irons were developed with a slight cavity, and some additional bulk positioned towards the center of gravity lower providing increased launch and spin for forgiveness and control. These irons feature a cambered leading edge and very slight offset, providing forgiveness and superior workability.

Shaft options include the KBS Tour V and C-Taper Lite.

products.body_html:
Limited Edition Black Forged Irons - Cavity Back
Sets include: 4-iron through Pitching Wedge

Inspired by the best players in the game, designed for golfers seeking maximum shot control with the traditional forged feel. The new Piretti Signature Forged Irons were designed with forgiveness and shotmaking in mind. Each club head is hand-ground to Piretti specifications for precision performance.

The Cavity Back Irons were developed with a more modern cavity blade to position the center of gravity lower providing increased launch and spin for forgiveness and control. All of the Piretti irons have a slightly rounded leading edge for less digging and precise turf performance.

products.body_html:
Piretti 801 Damascus Handstamped Putter

We are proud to introduce the first of eight one-off Piretti 801D Workshop putters. Damascus steel is known for its sleek look, beautiful aesthetics, and crisp yet soft feel. Creating a putter from Damascus is a tedious process involving folding metal as much as 32 times, with each layer being welded on top of one another. The result is a solid billet block that when milled into shape gives Damascus putters the unique wavy pattern that you see today.

products.title: Prototype Savona 3 Elite Black LN PN
products.body_html:
Meet the latest edition in the line of Piretti performance putters, the Savona 3 Elite.

This face-balanced mallet putter comes with a weight kit allowing variations of 360g, 370g, or 380g. Milled from a solid billet of 303 Stainless steel the elite series has an incredible feel, balance and retains the legendary Piretti quality. Features include a deep milled face, a black PVD finish for reduced glare, and a KBS steel shaft to achieve a face-balanced setup.

Designed with a modern refined styling and details that enhance both look and performance, the Elite Series was designed to look as good as it performs.

products.title: No-Torque Series Ferrara 2.5 365g
products.body_html:
The new No-Torque Series Putters feature a unique toe-up design that limits rotation and allows the putter head to stay square to the target line throughout the stroke.  Milled entirely from 303-stainless steel featuring a mid milled face for a quiet sound and buttery soft feel. Each of the head designs has been Tour tested and inspired by Mike Johnson’s desire for a true no-torque stroke while still obtaining a classic look and feel.  The satin finish is virtually maintenance free, and all of the Premier Series putters are paired with a KBS steel shaft, Piretti headcover, and our Piretti Touring Pro Black Grip.

The Ferrara 2.5 is a traditional wide blade with a center-shaft setup, and is milled to 365g from 303 stainless steel. The Ferrara 2.5 makes it easy to keep the putter square, just lineup and fire away!
